intro: Charlotte rewards visitors with a compact Uptown, leafy historic districts and a lively food and craft-beer scene. Pick how long you have and what you enjoy most.
tour_note: Check the tour page for which entry tickets are included.

notes: LYNX Blue Line light rail runs north-south, $2.20 one-way, $6.60 day pass.
CATS buses fan out from Uptown Transportation Center, $2.20 one-way.
CityLYNX Gold Line streetcar is free and links Uptown with Elizabeth.
Taxis are metered; Uber and Lyft operate widely.
Uptown is walkable, but outer districts are car-oriented; use a GPS.
Bikes and e-scooters (Bird, Lime) work best in Dilworth and Myers Park.

nascar_hall.name: NASCAR Hall of Fame
nascar_hall.price_text: ≈ USD 25–30 adult; child and senior rates lower — check on the day
nascar_hall.hours: Daily, roughly 10:00–17:00; check on the day
nascar_hall.tip: Try the racing simulators and the pit-crew challenge early before queues build.

carowinds.name: Carowinds
carowinds.price_text: ≈ USD 50–90 one-day ticket depending on date — buy online
carowinds.hours: Seasonal; usually spring to fall, check on the day
carowinds.tip: It straddles the NC/SC state line — grab a photo at the line marker. Arrive at opening for shorter coaster queues.

bojangles.name: Bojangles'
bojangles.hours: Most locations daily, early morning to late evening; check on the day
bojangles.tip: Order a biscuit with a Cajun chicken filet — it is the local breakfast staple.

frankies.name: Frankie's (Charlotte)
frankies.price_text: ≈ USD 15–35 depending on games and karting — check on the day
frankies.hours: Daily, usually late morning to late night; check on the day
frankies.tip: Go-karts and arcade are indoors, so it works on a rainy day or in the evening.

krispy_kreme.name: Krispy Kreme
krispy_kreme.hours: Most locations daily, early morning to evening; check on the day
krispy_kreme.tip: Watch for the 'Hot Now' sign and get a fresh original glazed straight off the line.

discovery_place.name: Discovery Place Science
discovery_place.price_text: ≈ USD 20–30 adult; child rates lower — check on the day
discovery_place.hours: Usually Tue–Sun, closed some Mondays; check on the day
discovery_place.tip: Good rainy-day pick for families; the IMAX and live science shows are the highlights.

mint_museum.name: The Mint Museum Uptown
mint_museum.price_text: ≈ USD 10–20 adult; some days free — check on the day
mint_museum.hours: Usually Tue–Sun; check on the day
mint_museum.tip: Pair it with the Bechtler next door for a compact art afternoon.

romare_bearden.name: Romare Bearden Park
romare_bearden.tip: Best at sunset with the Uptown skyline behind you — a top photo spot.

rail_trail.name: Charlotte Rail Trail
rail_trail.tip: Walk the paved path along the light rail through South End for murals, breweries and coffee stops.

southend_market.name: South End food and brewery strip
southend_market.price_text: ≈ USD 15–40 per person for food and a drink
southend_market.hours: Varies by venue; busiest evenings and weekends
southend_market.tip: Many taprooms cluster near the light rail — pick two and walk between them.

noda_walk.name: NoDa neighbourhood walk
noda_walk.price_text: Free to walk; pay per gallery, shop or bar
noda_walk.hours: Always open; galleries and bars have their own hours
noda_walk.tip: Charlotte's arts district — look for murals and the historic mill buildings. Check gallery hours before you go.

freedom_park.name: Freedom Park
freedom_park.tip: Shaded loop trail and a small lake — a calm break from Uptown crowds.

uptown_tour.name: Uptown walking or trolley tour
uptown_tour.price_text: ≈ USD 15–35 per person — check on the day
uptown_tour.tip: A guided intro helps you get your bearings on day one. Confirm the meeting point and whether tips are extra.

seventh_street.name: 7th Street Public Market
seventh_street.hours: Usually daily; check on the day
seventh_street.tip: Local vendors and coffee under one roof — handy for a quick lunch near Uptown.

bechtler.name: Bechtler Museum of Modern Art
bechtler.price_text: ≈ USD 8–15 adult; check on the day
bechtler.hours: Usually Tue–Sun; check on the day
bechtler.tip: Small and quick — good add-on if you are already at the Mint Museum.

optimist_hall.name: Optimist Hall food hall
optimist_hall.hours: Usually daily, lunch to evening; check on the day
optimist_hall.tip: Many local food stalls in a converted mill — go off-peak to grab a table.

levine_museum.name: Levine Museum of the New South
levine_museum.price_text: ≈ USD 8–15 adult; check on the day
levine_museum.hours: Usually Tue–Sun; check on the day
levine_museum.tip: Good context on Charlotte's history and growth — a useful primer before walking Uptown.

bbq_spot.name: Charlotte barbecue lunch
bbq_spot.hours: Varies by restaurant; check on the day
bbq_spot.tip: Carolina-style pulled pork with vinegar sauce is the local order — ask for hush puppies.

skyline_view.name: Skyline viewpoint from South End
skyline_view.tip: Look back toward Uptown from the Rail Trail at dusk for the best skyline photos.

brewery_tour.name: Local brewery tasting
brewery_tour.price_text: ≈ USD 10–30 for a flight or tour — check on the day
brewery_tour.hours: Usually afternoon to late evening; check on the day
brewery_tour.tip: Charlotte has a big craft-beer scene in South End and NoDa. Confirm tour times ahead.

styles.label: Culture
styles.blurb: NASCAR Hall of Fame, museums and historic Uptown.

styles.label: Food
styles.blurb: BBQ, Southern plates and a fast-growing brewery scene.

styles.label: Family
styles.blurb: Discovery Place, Carowinds and the U.S. National Whitewater Center.

stays.why: Walk to museums, sports venues and restaurants. Best base for a first visit without a car.
On the LYNX Blue Line, packed with breweries and rail-trail walks; quick ride to Uptown.
Quiet, leafy streets near Uptown; good for walking and biking, a short drive to most sights.
Arts district with live music, galleries and bars; on the Blue Line north of Uptown.

food: Try Carolina-style pulled pork BBQ with vinegar-based sauce; local BBQ joints range roughly $12–20 a plate.
Southern classics like shrimp and grits or fried chicken are easy to find; lunch plates often $10–18.
The brewery scene is strong in South End and NoDa; many taprooms allow outside food or have food trucks.
Uptown and South End food halls are good for groups and picky eaters; expect $10–15 per dish.
Check hours before you go: many kitchens close early on Sundays and Mondays.
more_time: Swap a city afternoon for the U.S. National Whitewater Center: rafting, ropes courses and trails; check prices and hours on the day.
Families can add a day at Carowinds amusement park on the city's south edge; check the seasonal calendar first.
History buffs can drive out to Historic Rosedale or the Charlotte Museum of History; confirm opening days before going.
